title: Comprehensive car insurance
description:
This includes cover for fire, theft and damage to someone else's car if you're in an accident.

But unlike our other levels of cover, it also covers the cost of repairing or replacing your car if it's in an accident or someone damages it on purpose.

We have four levels of comprehensive cover:

  • Admiral Essential
  • Admiral
  • Admiral Gold
  • Admiral Platinum

Apart from Essential tier, our comprehensive cover comes with extra benefits like windscreen cover and extended cover for driving outside the UK.
